create-design-guideline.short_description: Create, audit, and implement product design guidelines.
create-design-guideline.default_prompt: Use $create-design-guideline to create, audit, or implement a reusable design guideline for this product.
default_prompts: Create or revise a brand and product design guideline.
Audit the product's tokens, themes, and interaction states.
Implement the approved guideline and verify representative screens.

kiwi-design-system.short_description: Apply PIP and contribute shared design-system improvements.
kiwi-design-system.default_prompt: Use $kiwi-design-system to apply PIP to this product and propose useful shared improvements.
default_prompts: Apply PIP components and tokens to this product.
Propose and contribute a shared improvement to the Kiwi design system.

loboot.short_description: Safely manage and diagnose Loboot native user services.
loboot.default_prompt: Use $loboot to preview and safely configure this native user service.
default_prompts: Preview a Loboot user service without starting it.
Diagnose the runtime and activation state of a Loboot service.

locron.short_description: Safely operate, explain, and diagnose Locron.
locron.default_prompt: Use $locron to explain why this Locron job did not run.
default_prompts: Preview and safely create a Locron schedule.
Diagnose why a Locron job did not run.
